description: This document briefly surveys the current state of the Active Inference Institute and Active Inference Ecosystem, and outlines our future directions. It will be versioned as a living representation (both cyclic and updating) of ecosystems both general and local, describing the past, present, and future actions of the Active Inference Institute.

key_findings: The Institute traces its origin to a 2020 co-founder collaboration, the ActInfLab formed in 2021, and its 2022 transition into a Delaware non-profit.
The document reports that in 2022 there were 103 PubMed citations for "Active Inference" out of 1,772,674 publications.
The authors state the Institute has hosted or facilitated hundreds of open-source licensed products serving Awareness, Education, Commons, Support and Governance.
The authors identify key challenges including onboarding, tool usability, scalability of support functions, communications, and administrative and financial support.
The authors describe choosing an 'open' ecosystem approach over a closed, laboratory-centric one that might have siloed Active Inference academically.
key_findings_evidence: In 2022, ActInfLab made the developmental leap to become the Active Inference Institute, a non-profit formed in Delaware, USA
In the last complete year (2022), there were 103 citations for “Active Inference” of 1,772,674 publications total.

To date, The Institute has hosted or facilitated the development of hundreds of open-source licensed products which serve various functions in the Ecosystem including Awareness, Education, Commons, Support, and Governance
